name: TrainStrike
_intent: Heavy-bag combo jab-cross-hook-uppercut from an orthodox guard; every punch lands its fist ON the bag's front face 2.5 studs in front of the HumanoidRootPart, the other hand guards the chin, hips and the pivoting foot drive each punch, a little bounce.
_reference: boxing heavy-bag combination 1-2-3-uppercut, 2.0 s loop, hits at frames 6/18/30/42

keyframes._note: HIT jab: lead arm straight, fist on the bag face
jab snaps back off the bag
lead fist home, hips coil right to load the cross
HIT cross: rear hip and heel drive, right arm straight
cross home, left elbow lifts for the hook
HIT left hook: torso whips right, forearm level
dip: knees bend, right fist drops to the ribs
HIT right uppercut: legs drive up, forearm vertical
bounce on the balls of the feet

_contact.what: frontmost corner of the striking hand box at each Hit
